validity.value: Photos must be recent; two (2) recent passport-sized photos required per visa application

cross_verification.note_en: Eritrean Embassy (Washington DC) visa page confirms photo size only (35×45mm, matching DB's 3.5×4.5cm — no conflict). The Eritrean Embassy UK consular services page confirms quantity ('2 recent passport sized photos') and separately states the Eritrean Passport (not Visa) requires a 'pure white background' — that background rule was NOT applied to this visa entry to avoid over-extending a passport-specific statement to a different document type. No official Eritrean source could be found confirming head height, expression, glasses, headwear, or ear-visibility rules for the visa photo specifically; third-party aggregator claims (e.g. 'religious hats/scarfs only') were excluded per the truthfulness gate.
